remarks_1999: Double entries Downtown Gallery Archive. Whitney Archive indicates, "Painted 1931. Title [The Mountain, New Mexico] given by Rosalind Irvine [this title crossed out by O'Keeffe in Abiquiú Notebooks]. Check with catalogue if one is found, See Gallery photograph" [photograph not verified]. Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks, date 1931. Backing inscriptions 1,4, date 1930. Downtown Gallery Archive dates 1930 and 1931. Dated 1930 on basis of backing inscriptions. Not pictured in 1931–32 New York (An American Place) installation photographs. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: Rolling gray and brown hills dominate the composition. Small green bushes dot the hills. A sliver of blue sky with fluffy white clouds is visible above the landscape.
